smiles.derivation: Candidate SMILES transcribed conservatively from the source drawing or explicit chemical name; parsing does not certify identity.

atom_centers.derivation: RDKit graph diagnostic on the candidate SMILES; source assignment takes precedence.

double_bonds.derivation: RDKit graph diagnostic; absence of a source E/Z label remains unspecified.

assignment.normalized_value: No atom-centred stereogenic element is present in the asserted candidate graph; this does not assign any unencoded conformational chirality.
assignment.derivation: Stereochemical status is limited to what can be established from the visible drawing and candidate graph.

chirality_status.derivation: Status does not infer racemic composition from absent stereomarks.

geometry_status.derivation: Visible alkene geometry is left unspecified unless the source explicitly assigns it.

representation_status.derivation: Candidate encoding is partial when source stereochemistry is unassigned or cumulene handling is limited.
